frozen_selection_record.panel_rule: round-robin topology,fg_hierarchy,fragment_descriptors; original ID ascending within each source; max12
frozen_selection_record.mechanism_rule: first3 fragment IDs in C with D positive and negative molecules each>=200; no replacement after downstream gates

aggregate_source_records.intervals: Each condition has its own 95% molecule-bootstrap CI; no difference CI or new test

moved_to_SI.destination: existing SI Table S-I2 and its full-precision companion CSV

physical_layout.state_glyph_omission_reason: Theta/Ginit axes contain scientific transfer values, not the four initialization/training and native/rotation conditions; no semantically matching pre-existing glyph
physical_layout.A_width_specification_scope: 4.6in panel including labels; 4.1in actual data axes
physical_layout.width_change_reason: 2.2in actual B data axes plus y ticks and Ginit label collided at old width; added 0.30in without scaling either panel
